run_BMGInference_infer: run BMGInference _infer method to get samples and a performance report from queries and observations
create_graph_with_performance_data: create a Bean Machine graph and enable performance data collection with collect_performance_data
fetch_performance_report_json: fetch the raw JSON performance report string from a graph after running inference
parse_json_to_perf_report: parse a JSON performance report string into a structured perf_report object using json_to_perf_report
tidy_perf_report_string: tidy a performance report string by normalizing timestamps, durations, and call counts for comparison
